snippet.title: Energy Crush [ エネルギークラッシュ ] // Teaser
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3314090/_/

This is a 2D online shooting game. Up to four players can play against each other. It is still in development, so there is only one mode and few types of players. I would like to hear the opinions of users, so I would appreciate it if you could review it even if it is a small thing.

Developed by
Hiroshi Kimura
